culture_principles.name: Be the Better Bank
culture_principles.description: TD-style fit connects work to improving banking for clients, colleagues, and communities.

culture_principles.name: Remarkably human, refreshingly simple
culture_principles.description: Strong answers show customer empathy, simplicity, clear communication, and practical service improvement.

culture_principles.name: Own it, raise it, know it
culture_principles.description: TD risk culture rewards ownership, escalation, risk knowledge, and doing the right thing within risk appetite.

culture_principles.name: Care, inclusion, and community impact
culture_principles.description: TD culture emphasizes inclusive workplace, colleague care, customer care, and community contribution.

hiring_signals.signal: Aligns skills and career stories to the specific role while showing contribution to TD's Better Bank vision.
Shows customer empathy, simplicity, and practical action in banking or service situations.
Owns and escalates risk appropriately instead of hiding issues or optimizing short-term sales metrics.
Shows inclusive leadership, mentoring, and colleague/community care, especially in people-facing and banking roles.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Sales or productivity answer that ignores customer suitability, risk, or escalation.
anti_signals.risk_reason: TD risk culture emphasizes doing the right thing and Own it, Raise it, Know it.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic bank-interest answer without role alignment or customer/community impact.
anti_signals.risk_reason: TD interview tips ask candidates to align skills to the role and explain contribution to Be the Better Bank.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Treating inclusion and care as soft extras rather than operating expectations.
anti_signals.risk_reason: TD public materials frame inclusion, care, and community as core culture signals.

interview_patterns.pattern: General TD interviews should test role alignment, customer stories, thoughtful questions, culture contribution, and career success examples.
Retail/personal banking interviews should test customer empathy, difficult interactions, suitability, compliance, and service-to-sales judgment.
Corporate/technology/risk roles should test risk ownership, escalation, simplification, execution, stakeholder communication, and data-informed decisions.

honest_limits: This is a public-source and private-distillation draft lens and does not represent an official TD hiring standard.
Private materials authorized by the project owner are included only as distilled aggregate patterns, not raw article text or copied questions.
TD role expectations vary across Canada, U.S., retail banking, contact center, corporate, technology, risk, wealth, and capital markets.
This v0.1 lens has static validation cases but is not approved for production screening until live answer backtesting and reviewer approval are complete.
This v0.2 lens has structured evidence records and an evidence audit, but is still not approved for production screening.
Public source URLs and private-material provenance must be reviewed before v1.0 approval.
